title: Aaron Glenn’s praise of Frank Reich invites scrutiny

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Aaron Glenn’s praise of Frank Reich invites scrutiny
sources.description: After the Jets’ Week 6 loss to the Patriots, offensive coordinator Frank Reich has been a target of fan and media criticism for his playcalling. Head coach Aaron Glenn said positive things about Reich’s performance to the media on Wednesday. Asked if the offensive struggles might prompt him to get more involved in helping Frank […]
